title: Local divisibility in a principal thickening kernel
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, g an element of R, and W an open subscheme of Spec R [def-pc-scheme]. For k a natural number let W_k be openThickening for R to R/(g) [lem-sbc-finite-etale-adic-sections-transfer]. If a is a global section of O_W restricting to zero on W_k, then every point x of W has an open neighbourhood V in W and b in Gamma(V,O_W) such that a|V=(g|V)^(k+1)b. Here g|W is the canonical restriction through GammaSpecIso.

source.place: Tags 01QQ and 01JU, affine closed subschemes and quotient base change; ordinary quotient sheaf of Tag 0H3E.

proof.text: Put K=ker(R to R/(g))^(k+1). Apply quotientBaseChange_closedImmersion_ideal to W to obtain the closed immersion i:W_k to W and the formula ker(i.app V)=K extended to Gamma(V,O_W) for every affine open V of W. This is exactly the existing quotient base-change theorem, specialized to a principal power.

Choose an affine neighbourhood V of x. Naturality restricts the zero image of a to V, placing a|V in ker(i.app V). The quotient kernel is (g), and Ideal.span_singleton_pow identifies K with (g^(k+1)). Ideal.map_span and Ideal.mem_span_singleton give the desired coefficient b. The appLE formula identifies the generator with the restriction of the canonical section g|W.

lean.statement:
theorem principal_thickening_local_division
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (k : ℕ) (a : Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤))
    (ha : (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W k).appTop a = 0) :
    ∀ x : W.toScheme, ∃ (V : W.toScheme.Opens), x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ b : Γ(W.toScheme, V),
        W.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op a =
          (W.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
            (((ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ W.ι.appTop) g)) ^ (k + 1) * b
